title: Non-musical family background
summary: His mother was a ballet teacher; no musicians in the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: This passion you have for music, is there is precedent for it in your parents or your grandparents or anything? Where’d it come from?

My mom was a dancer, a ballet dancer. She had a dancing school, a dance academy on Long Island. My father is not, you know, they’re not musicians. And we wonder about that. I mean I really don’t know where that came from. It was just, I don’t know. I guess it’s a blessing and a curse. Well I really don’t know because there haven’t been any musicians in my family. The closest thing I can come to is my mom’s dancing.
So there’s some artistic genes going on.
